claim_boundary: This contract discriminates only the P1425 fragment frozen by the manifest. It does not establish general math parity, change attachment geometry, or grant credit for Rust representation or render-byte equality.

classification.Preserved: All required public-language observations for the case are established with an attributable witness.
classification.Unknown: Identity, execution, parsing, extraction, dependency, or budget prevents a sound decision. Unknown is fail-closed and cannot satisfy a mandatory case or reject a mutation.
classification.Violated: At least one required observation differs, with a witness naming the observable and actual result.

observables.O-BILATERAL-CONVERGENCE: Bare limits syntax and qualified math.limits calls with equivalent arguments converge on the same body, limits, inline, explicit-presence morphology, repr, and established layout behavior.
observables.O-BINDING: math.limits is a callable function in the closed math module with public name limits and is distinct from scripts.
observables.O-CARRIER-PRESENCE: MathLimitsOverride stores body, limits, inline, and a causal inline_explicit bit; omission differs from explicit true even though both carry inline=true.
observables.O-FAIL-CLOSED: Ambiguous, crashed, timed-out, swapped, OOM, unreadable, truncated, or unsupported observations never become Preserved or mutation rejection credit.
observables.O-LAYOUT-PRESERVATION: inline_explicit is morphology-only. Existing limits/inline attachment geometry, class, body text, emptiness, and default italic recursion remain unchanged.
observables.O-REPR: limits repr always begins with body and emits inline only when inline_explicit is true, including explicit true; scripts repr never emits inline.
observables.O-SCRIPTS-CONTROL: Qualified and bare scripts preserve limits=false, inline=true by convention, inline_explicit=false, scripts repr, and never-stacked semantics.
observables.O-SIGNATURE: Qualified math.limits accepts exactly one required positional Content body and only optional inline: bool default true; all measured rejected forms retain their public diagnostic fragments.
observables.O-WALKERS: All carrier reconstructions and walkers preserve inline_explicit; map_content recurses only into body, map_text remains terminal, plain_text/is_empty delegate, and equality observes the field.

unknown_policy: Fail closed exactly as frozen in the manifest. Unknown is acceptable only as the expected result of U01-U04; it blocks P01-P11 and N01-N05, contributes neither numerator nor rejection credit, and prevents sealing when produced by a required case or a valid mutation.
